name: social_hack
description: DisasterBridge — disaster response coordination for people with disabilities

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,resident,earthquake-sim -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w resident" "npm run dev --prefix simulation -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174"
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w resident && npm run start -w server
